Energy is calculated by integrating battery power V × I over time. Negative power while driving indicates regeneration. Intervals up to 60 s between readings are included. Energy during longer gaps is unknown.

Energy is calculated by integrating battery power over time. Gross use adds discharge, recovered energy adds regeneration, and net energy is their difference. Gaps between readings can reduce calculation coverage.
